Use official 14 km display and preserve computed lengths for normalization.

Official title says Röå while logistics/service/geometry evidence identifies the functional endpoint as Röåsjön shelter/stage-4 junction. Use Röå / Röåsjön label and the official geometry endpoint, not a generic Röå geocode.

Current OSM relation 1173503 reaches Röå/Röåsjön, but starts at the OSM stage-2 boundary about 415 m from the official KML/Naturkartan Mölltorp boundary. Do not import raw OSM stage boundaries without correcting the start.
OSM wiki label truncates stage 3 to Mölltorp-Gunnarflon, but current OSM relation and official sources include Röå/Röåsjön.

Older official PDF broadly says fire bans apply in reserves; current Länsstyrelsen guidance says protected-area fire rules vary. Stora Röå current listed rules do not include a blanket fire ban, while nearby Röå alsumpskog explicitly prohibits fire and camping. Recheck before public display.
Naturkartan route objects reportedly had empty regulations, but nearby reserve pages have actual restrictions. Empty route regulations must not be interpreted as no restrictions.

Found official KML/Naturkartan two-segment linework, computed 13.175 km assembled route, Klevaberget spur, endpoint continuity, and OSM relation 1173503 current extent/boundary mismatch.
Identified Röåsjön shelter cluster as core on-route facility; Gunnarflon as junction metadata only; Mölltorp services; and Brevik/Breviks Camping/Golf off-route service candidates.

Confirmed strong start access via Mölltorp line 400/Närtrafik, official midpoint exit via Rankåsleden to Fagersanna, no direct transit at Röåsjön, and Breviks Camping/Vättersvallen as practical vehicle/service access.

Found Pacer 2025 direct route-app update, overlapping AllTrails 2025 good-condition/clear-marking report, stale 2019 direct reverse-direction narrative, and Röåsjön shelter road-noise/mosquito/water caveats.
